# Curly Fries

Curly Fries is the irritable, extravagantly moustached Ranger who becomes the heroes' favorite scapegoat — and eventually a surprisingly sympathetic ally. He is a supporting character in [Fallout Equestria: Heroes](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/662/fallout-equestria-heroes), the side novel by No One, first published in 2011. He belongs to that fan-created continuity, rather than the official Friendship is Magic television continuity.

- **Appearance:** A distinctive drooping moustache and pink-and-green coloring. The text is inconsistent: chapter 11 describes a pink coat and cropped green mane, whereas chapter 38 describes a green stallion with a long pink mane. His later red-tinted power armor bears painted apples.
- **Name and role:** Curly Fries is his actual name in the novel, not a nickname invented by readers. Paladin is a military title. He serves the Caledonian Steel Rangers before his exile and subsequent affiliation with the Applejack Rangers. No separate secret identity or name origin was verified.
- **Speaking status:** Extensive written dialogue. The [Heroes audiobook overview](https://falloutequestria.fandom.com/wiki/Fallout:_Equestria_-_Heroes) identifies Equestria Narrator as the reader of its single-narrator adaptation; no separately credited character voice was verified.
- **Running joke:** Hired Gun, Flare and Serenity blame him for practically everything, as seen in [chapter 20, Graveyard Of Good Intentions](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/662/21/fallout-equestria-heroes/chapter-20-graveyard-of-good-intentions).

## Important moments

These are novel chapters, not television episodes. Verified audio timestamps are unavailable.

- **Demanding respect** — [Chapter 11: Knowing Is Half The Battle](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/662/12/fallout-equestria-heroes/chapter-11-knowing-is-half-the-battle). His interrogation of Flare establishes their mutual hostility and the grievances behind it.
- **A change of allegiance** — [Chapter 36: Convergence](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/662/37/fallout-equestria-heroes/chapter-36-convergence). After exile, he brings Applejack Rangers south and acknowledges Hired Gun's potential, showing how far his outlook has changed.
- **Thanking Flare** — [Chapter 38: How to Start a War in Ten Days](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/662/39/fallout-equestria-heroes/chapter-38-how-to-start-a-war-in-ten-days). He admits he may have misjudged his old enemy and thanks him for saving his remaining family, without dismissing their painful history.
- **Seven years later** — [Epilogue](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/662/42/fallout-equestria-heroes/epilogue-seven-years-later). He reports helping secure Dise and grudgingly acknowledges Hired Gun's achievements.
